name: Audit Your Sleep Environment
instructions: Check your room temperature -- most people sleep best between 60-67°F (15-19°C); a room that runs warm disrupts deep sleep.
Block out light sources: streetlights, standby LEDs, or gaps in curtains can all interrupt melatonin production.
Reduce noise where you can, or add a consistent background sound (a fan or white noise) to mask sudden disruptions.
Follow tonight's wind-down meditation once your environment is set up for the night.
